settings.api_token.label: API token (optional)
settings.api_token.description: Leave empty to use the public AJAX status API instead (no key needed, rate-limited to ~1 request/15s, shared across every instance of this widget). Request a token via the form on api.ukrainealarm.com to use that API instead.
settings.poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.poll_seconds.description: How often to poll the alert status. With no API token (public API), this is floored at 15s regardless of what you set here.
settings.primary_output.label: Primary output (optional)
settings.primary_output.description: Optional. Set a connector name (e.g. eDP-1) to make only the widget instance on that output actually poll the API. Instances on every other output stop fetching and just mirror that instance's last result for the same region - useful with a mirrored/multi-monitor bar so you're not polling twice for no reason. Leave empty for the old behavior: every instance fetches independently.
widget.mirror_waiting: Waiting for the primary output's first result…
widget.mirror_stale: No recent update from the primary output. Right-click for settings.
settings.region_id.label: Region ID (ukrainealarm.com)
settings.region_id.description: Only used when an API token is set in the plugin's settings. Find it via GET https://api.ukrainealarm.com/api/v3/regions (with your token) and pick the oblast/raion/community id for this widget instance to watch.
settings.ajax_region.label: Region (public API)
settings.ajax_region.description: Only used when no API token is set in the plugin's settings. Pick the region this widget instance should watch. To watch another region, add this widget to the bar again and pick a different one here.
settings.alert_scope.label: Alert scope (public API)
settings.alert_scope.description: Only used when no API token is set. "Whole region only" counts just alerts declared for the picked region itself. "Include districts" also counts alerts declared for districts/communities inside it - the badge then lights up when any part of the region is under alert.
widget.unconfigured_region_id: Set a region ID in this widget's settings (right-click) — or clear the API token to use the free public API instead.
widget.unconfigured_ajax_region: Pick your region in this widget's settings (right-click).
widget.parse_error: Could not read the alert response.
widget.level.red: RED - air raid alert, take shelter
